name: json2dir-syscall
description: Linux kernel module: writing '<base-path> NUL <json>' to /sys/kernel/json2dir/data builds the tree in kernel space. Run sandboxed: each case boots linux-7.2.9 under QEMU (TCG) with the target directory shared over 9p; never loaded into the host kernel
build:
# Kernel bzImage + external-module build tree come from {runtimes}/linux-7.2.9/build-kernel.sh.
make KDIR={runtimes}/linux-7.2.9/build && {runtimes}/json2dir-syscall-vm/mkbase.sh json2dir.ko
